# AR Medias

> AR Medias is an IT services company founded on 1 January 2024 by Aryan Yadav in New Delhi, India. It builds websites, mobile apps, custom software, CRM and ERP systems, and AI-powered workflow automation for businesses in India, the UAE, USA, Canada, Australia, Japan and China.
